text.text_excerpt: So glad they opened a Winn-Dixie in Mid-City! Not only is it convenient, but it's in a good location. I like that they have "half" shopping carts (maybe I just don't go shopping that much so I don't know when stores started implementing these), but they're definitely easier to maneuver around. Not to mention, this store is clean! Only thing they need to work on is customer service. I did a promo here, and the staff wasn't very much help. The manager didn't even come out from the back to meet me. Also the parking lot is like a pack of sardines! Because of all the businesses the lot is ALWAYS pretty much full and cars are constantly backing up so watch out for that!

I drive up to this Winn Dixie from downtown and consider it my "home base" grocery store. I started shopping at Winn Dixie for the fuel perks so was very excited when this new location opened because it was all the more convenient for me. Please note: I am a self-proclaimed grocery shopping hater and try to avoid doing it as much as possible. But this large, clean store makes it bearable when I do have to shop. Once you've found a parking spot (which can be difficult sometimes), the store never seemed jammed or crowded. This is a fairly new Winn Dixie and what a great location. It's right in the heart of Mid City and has a nice, big, parking lot. Truth be told, on occasion I have trouble finding a spot because they share the lot with a group of businesses that front Carrollton. Today, luckily, I had no problem parking. The store is clean and spacious. The produce looks fresh, the meat section is full of good stuff - I mean they are the "beef people", right? - the dairy case is well stocked and they have lots of frozen goods. The bakery had lots of tasty looking goodies, but I resisted. Maybe next time. The employees are friendly and if you use your rewards card, the savings can be significant. All in all...
